key_changes: Added CandidateManifest model for contract binding
Added CandidateIntegrityError exception
Added verify_candidate_integrity() for server-side hash verification
Added sha256_file() utility for file hashing
Created comprehensive unit tests for integrity verification
Implemented PlacementAction enum (ADD/UPDATE/EXTEND/REUSE/REJECT)
Implemented ArtifactPlacement and PlacementManifest models
Implemented normalize_artifact_name() to strip version suffixes (V2, V3, etc.)
Implemented find_semantic_match() to prevent duplicate file creation
Implemented build_placement_manifest() with canonical artifact policy
Implemented build_repository_index() to extract artifacts from snapshot
Created 28 comprehensive unit tests covering all placement scenarios
Added AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL gate enforcement
Created /workflows/{workflow_id}/approve-placement endpoint
Implemented WorkflowApprovalPayload and WorkflowApprovalResponse schemas
Added register_workflow_for_approval() helper function
Added transition_to_approval_gate() state transition function
Implemented manifest hash verification (prevents tampering)
Implemented contract hash verification (detects drift)
Added workflow state validation (must be in AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL)
State transitions: AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL -> IMPLEMENTING (approve) or REJECTED (reject)
No auto-approval bypass - requires explicit human action
Created BrowserVerifier class with Playwright integration
Implemented BrowserCheckResult and BrowserVerificationReport models
Added _check_playwright() for Playwright availability detection
Implemented verify() method with SKIPPED status when Playwright unavailable
Added placeholder methods for visual, console, accessibility, and responsive checks
Documented that SKIPPED is NOT a certification blocker
Created 13 comprehensive unit tests validating all status types
